label: Tasks
empty_hint: No active or recently-finished tasks for this machine.

actions.label: Steer — read the card & answer
actions.description: Read the card prose and answer its form, then wake the worker. The agent acts on your answer only — including casting a PR verdict solely when a card's form asks for one and you pick it (review cards), never autonomously.

actions.label: View charter — what this task is
actions.description: Read this task's charter: a short description plus structured metadata (registrar, source, linked artifacts). Read-only — never mutates the task. Not yet populated by the real board (see `board_cli._build`'s `has_charter` note) — gated off rather than shown blank until it is.

actions.label: Worktree status — session, claims, commits
actions.description: Drill into the claiming worktree: session lineage, an expanded status descriptor (turns, commits, claims), and its claim graph. Read-only.

actions.label: Open into a CLI session
actions.description: PROPOSED — not yet wired. Would open (or, for Proposed/Queued, create) this task's worktree into an interactive Copilot CLI session via Phase 1 item 3's ownership transaction (`agent-dispatch embody --interactive`). Currently gated off (`board_cli`'s `cli_openable` is hard-`False`): the generic Worktrees `open-cli` internal verb this action currently names has no `target_worktree` to find for a Proposed/Queued task and bypasses the ownership transaction for a Suspended one. Needs its own dedicated internal verb before this can be safely enabled -- Phase 7's own scope (pure UI wiring onto Phase 2's now-landed CLI verbs).

actions.label: Kick to a headless bridge agent
actions.description: Spawn a background bridge agent on this machine to work the task.

actions.label: Pause the agent (user hold — blocks re-queue)
actions.description: Suspends the assigned agent's re-queue eligibility AND blocks agent-dispatch from re-queuing this task until you explicitly unpause it. Distinct from anything an agent would do on its own; remember to come back and unpause it.

actions.label: Unpause the agent
actions.description: Clears a hold set by Pause, re-admitting the task to re-queue/resume eligibility on its normal schedule.

actions.label: Force-stop the agent
actions.description: Immediately terminates the process embodying this task (best-effort) and parks it Suspended. The task itself is not abandoned — it becomes eligible for resume/re-embodiment on the normal schedule.

actions.label: Reset to Proposed
actions.description: Sends the task back to Proposed (unapproved) — the gentler way to say "not like this" without terminally abandoning the idea. Preserves the task's durable goal/done-criteria/progress log for a fresh attempt.

actions.label: Force-abandon the task
actions.description: Terminally abandon this task — the user's way to say "No".
